counts.requestBasis: Frozen manifest snapshot including settled invalid charges; pending ledgers not read.

positionBalance.interpretation: Four planned cyclic replicates balance four positions; not randomized. Stopped or invalid subsets may retain only partial balance.

limitations.meaning: Help/details openings show observable access, not reading or understanding. Basic saved from an initial default is not an explicit scope-basic action.
limitations.carry: Pending scope starts basic; explicit scope buttons and quick extended update it. Navigation and disabling notifications do not reset it. Every enable event records its original source and whether a prior selection was carried.
limitations.comparison: All six first-model-distribution TV comparisons require matching initial PNG/native-minus-Persona input/candidate action mapping/source/config. Small n=4 gives six within and sixteen cross pairs when complete; pair distances are correlated descriptive outputs, not independent statistical evidence.
limitations.profiles: A/B/C differ as complete knowledge/experience/expectation/tendency bundles; names are also model inputs. No single-trait causality or human-fit inference.
limitations.selfReports: Recorded reasons/native conditions/assessment are model self-reports, not internal cognition or verified understanding.
limitations.limits: Invalid/pending/unattempted trials are outside behavior denominators, with no zero imputation; invalid prefixes and imposed caps remain separate.
